name: Synn
message: 「Nothing beats how refreshing the morning air is」
I took it for granted back when I was working part-time, so it feels a little novel now.

name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Sasami. Full of energy today too, huh」
I-It's not like I was getting my hopes up or anything.

name: Synn
message: 「As for the vegetable garden…… no issues here」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing to harvest today either, so maybe I'll do some radio calisthenics until Nanaka gets here」

name: Macaron
message: 「Could this be your house, big brother?」

name: Macaron
message: 「H-Hmph. Well, it's not bad, I suppose?」

name: Synn
message: 「Unfortunately, most of the rooms are empty, though」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mgh, when it comes to size, mine won't lose... probably」

name: Macaron
message: 「M-My parents' house is huge! Super luxurious! Actually, it's a castle!」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, where do you live now?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm deliberately not telling you so I don't get attacked by you, Big Brother. It's privacy protection」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Whoa, attacked!? I wouldn't do anything that bad」

name: Synn
message: 「You little, you don't trust me at all」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nope! Because you've got that kind of face, Big Brother」

name: Synn
message: 「M-My face, huh. Well, nothing I can do about that」
Mom, Dad, I won't hold a grudge over something like this.

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, I think you have a pretty gallant face」

name: Macaron
message: 「Just a little. Just a tiny little bit」

name: Macaron
message: 「Actually, you know, haven't we... met before, way earlier?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, never mind that, what were you doing just now? A punishment game? Some kind of special training?」

name: Macaron
message: 「No thanks. I'm in the middle of work」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. Unlike you doing that tasteless dance, big bro, I'm busy」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I know. I've got free time right now, so let me help out a bit」

name: Macaron
message: 「This is my job, so don't go stealing it from me!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm fine. I can handle this much all by myself」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even though you used to do the exact same thing all the time, big bro」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it was to make a living, after all...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then it's the exact same for me!」
So Macaron really was working hard just to get by, too!

name: Macaron
message: 「Becoming a splendid Demon King is my whole life, after all!」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's why I'm not gonna rely on your help, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Well, I'll accept the thought, at least!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I guess all I can do is cheer you on」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, are you sure? And three of them, too」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's fine! Uncle Amakawa told me to take 'em anyway」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Besides, I owed you a bunch of favors anyway, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ngh~! In that case, it's thanks for helping me look for a part-time job! I still hadn't thanked you yet!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Good! With things like this, you're supposed to just accept them honestly!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, I'm in the middle of deliveries, so I'm gonna get going!」
To get a share of that energy, I immediately take the cap off the milk.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? What's this, Synn? You're up early today」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, good morning, Nanaka. Sometimes I wake up early」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hahaha! You sound like an old man」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Never mind that, hurry up and get ready for school」
I should probably go wake up Paqy soon, too.
